================================================================
  Third-party licenses for Tharkys the Knight (desktop wrapper)
================================================================

Tharkys the Knight ships as a single executable that statically
links several open-source components, embeds a small portion of
the ZX Spectrum 128K ROM (Amstrad-licensed redistribution), and
uses an 8x8 bitmap font. Below are the licenses for each of them.

----------------------------------------------------------------
  Reward font (in-game text)
----------------------------------------------------------------
"Reward" is part of the ZX Origins font collection.
Copyright (c) 1988-2023 Damien Guard <damieng@gmail.com>
https://damieng.com/zx-origins

Permission is granted to use the font in games (commercial or
non-commercial), printed materials, websites and OS terminals.
The only prohibited use is redistributing the font as a standalone
font asset (re-hosting on another site, bundling with other art
assets, etc).

A credit of the form
    "Reward font by DamienG  https://damieng.com/zx-origins"
in any credits screen is appreciated. Tharkys credits Damien in
its in-game ending sequence.

The full license text shipped with the font is in
code/fonts/REWARD_LICENSE.md in the source repository.

----------------------------------------------------------------

  1. The origin of this software must not be misrepresented; you
     must not claim that you wrote the original software. If you

     product documentation would be appreciated but is not
     required.
  2. Altered source versions must be plainly marked as such, and
     must not be misrepresented as being the original software.
  3. This notice may not be removed or altered from any source
     distribution.

----------------------------------------------------------------
  Sinclair ZX Spectrum 128K ROM
----------------------------------------------------------------
The 128K ROM images embedded in the wrapper are the
Amstrad-blessed free redistribution from 1999. They remain
copyright of Amstrad plc; use is permitted in emulators and
emulator-based products.

ROM binaries fetched at build time from
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/floooh/chips-test/master/examples/roms/zx-roms.h

----------------------------------------------------------------
  SJASMPLUS (build-time only; not bundled in the binary)
----------------------------------------------------------------
The Z80 assembler used to build the game's .sna / .tap files is
sjasmplus, released under the BSD-3 license. It is a build-time
tool; no part of sjasmplus is shipped in tharkys.exe.

https://github.com/z00m128/sjasmplus
